choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: Well, beneath this uniform beats one of the bravest and noblest hearts in the whole army.
Albert has not deceived us, for the count is a most singular being. What say you, Morrel!
Ali, with considerable animation, made a sign in the affirmative.
